title: No Such Thing as Too Much
description: Count container combinations that exactly hold 150 liters of eggnog.
writeup:
## Approach

With ~20 containers, the total number of subsets is 2^20 ≈ 1 million — easily brute-forceable by iterating over all combinations of each size.

## Part 1

Count all subsets of containers whose capacities sum to exactly 150. Iterate through combination sizes 1 to N using `itertools.combinations`.

## Part 2

Find the minimum number of containers needed among valid combinations, then count how many combinations use exactly that many containers.
